question: What division of eightfold groups is sought to be known fully?
premises: A division of eight groups of eight is mentioned.
Full knowledge of this division is desired.
The knowing is described as endless or thorough.
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and thoroughly the division of the eight groups of eight.
uncertainties: anantathā may mean endlessly or in infinite detail
plain_english: And to know fully, in all its extent, the division of the eight groups of eight.
